cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write to the manufacturer. Your shelf fell because they supplied the wrong bracket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You fitted it upside down. Look at the arrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll complain about the arrow. I'll hold the bracket while you photograph it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You drew that arrow. I watched you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Photograph both sides, then. I'll put in the complaint that they made us draw our own safety markings.

reason: Specify the bracket as the object A holds and B photographs; no changed plot or additional excuse, only removal of the ambiguous physical referent.
